Subject: Initiation and disposal of 14B & 7Q Inquiries -reg

Madan/Sir,

As per the target set by the ministry for recovery for the current financial year
(2024-25), it is directed that all 14B and 7Q inquiries that have been initiated shall be
closed by 31.08.2024. For inquiries that have not been initiated yet, they shall be
initiated by 31.07.2024 and thereafter should be closed within next three months.
Furthermore, 7Q and 14B cases where dues are above 50 lacs may be given special

emphasis, and the initiation and disposal of such cases may be taken on priority.

All Zonal Offices are also requested to regularly monitor the officer-wise
performance in this regard within their jurisdiction. Progress reports should be

submitted to the head office on the 15th of every month in the enclosed format.

Yours faithfully,

1.06:

(Chandramauli Chakraborty)
Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner (HQ) (Recovery)
